experiment: story-2 30-40 s / ~91 words; club in hook (Barcelona's Raphinha + Ancelotti, 2 red cards), beat 1 present-day surprise 'Substituted', question at ~18 s

beats.say: Two red cards. Barcelona's Raphinha and Ancelotti, both sent off.
beats.caption: 2 red cards. Barcelona's Raphinha and Ancelotti, both sent off.

beats.say: Substituted. Brazil's captain for the day was already off the pitch.
beats.caption: Substituted. Brazil's captain for the day was already off the pitch.

card.sub: captain for the day · Endrick came on for him

beats.say: Ninety-first minute, Japan win it three-two. Brazil want a foul. Raphinha and Ancelotti protest on the touchline. Both off.
beats.caption: 91st minute, Japan win it 3-2. Brazil want a foul. Raphinha and Ancelotti protest on the touchline. Both off.

card.sub: Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's winner · Brazil wanted a foul on João Gomes

beats.say: Captain, substituted, sent off. Right to protest, or should a captain keep his head?
beats.caption: Captain, substituted, sent off. Right to protest, or should a captain keep his head?

card.text:
RIGHT TO PROTEST?
OR *KEEP HIS HEAD*?
card.sub: Barcelona's Raphinha captained Brazil for the day

beats.say: Ancelotti blamed the ref: I don't think he had the experience to handle this kind of game.
beats.caption: Ancelotti blamed the ref: "I don't think he had the experience to handle this kind of game."

card.text:
…IT'S NOT HIS FAULT. …
I DON'T THINK HE HAD
THE EXPERIENCE TO HANDLE
*THIS KIND OF GAME.*

beats.say: Three days later, both watched from the stands as Brazil thrashed Singapore seven-nil.
beats.caption: 3 days later, both watched from the stands as Brazil thrashed Singapore 7-0.
